October 3rd 2026
Version 13.14.x (stable) / 13.15.x (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Mandatory update: please install it. (K,R)
* Major improvements to data integrity. (K,R)
* More reliable communication with the accordion. (R)
* User interface improvements. (K,R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...
notes_beta:
October 13th 2026
Version 13.16.x (stable) / 13.17.x (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* New DAW plugin "K-Configurator Bridge", Mac and Windows. (K,R)
*   Logic Pro (AU). (K,R)
*   Cubase, Nuendo, Studio One (VST3). (K,R)
*   Reaper (VST3 or CLAP). (K,R)
*   Bitwig Studio (CLAP or VST3). (K,R)
* Installs with the app; see Help->DAW plugin. (K,R)
* Free Bass picture: rows rise like a real Bajan. (K,R)
* Live Transcription: better note values, Halve/Double. (K,R)
* New MIDI Monitor & Chord Analyzer: see what you play. (K,R)
* Play MIDI and MusicXML files on the accordion. (R)
* Chord names: jazz, Stradella or Roman numerals. (K,R)
* FISA SUPREMA: MIDI Monitor over USB cable or Bluetooth. (K)
* Live Editor: larger, easier-to-read buttons and captions. (R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...
